control: untouched real test partition from the same seed

singling_out.knowledge: up to three predicates across the released feature columns; no identifier columns

inference.auxiliary_rule: all original feature columns except the secret (16 columns); includes the other secret

randomness: seed each independent attack cell and verify repeated outputs; fail if an unseeded RNG path remains
interpretation: control-adjusted attack risk with native Anonymeter confidence intervals; correlated inference that succeeds equally in control is not evidence of membership leakage
